picks.headline: Reflection AI releases Reflection Beam, a 501B open-weight sparse MoE
picks.why: It introduces a 501B parameter open-weight agentic coding model with 23B active parameters deployed directly on AWS and vLLM.
picks.title: Introducing Reflection Beam: an open-weight model for agentic coding on AWS

picks.headline: Microsoft and NVIDIA publish enterprise risk framework for open-weight models
picks.why: Provides a standardized enterprise taxonomy and mitigation framework for operationalizing open-weight LLMs safely.
picks.title: Managing open-weight model risk in enterprise deployments

picks.headline: TorchTitan adds Zephon for elastic deterministic data loading across GPU resizes
picks.why: Ensures strict, reproducible global batch ordering during distributed LLM training even when cluster allocations scale dynamically.
picks.title: Bringing Elastically Deterministic Data Loading to TorchTitan with Zephon

picks.headline: INFUSE benchmark evaluates indirect prompt injection in long-horizon agents
picks.why: Fills a critical gap in security testing by evaluating indirect injection attacks across realistic multi-step agent workflows.
picks.title: INFUSE: A Unified Surface Benchmark for Indirect Prompt Injection in Agentic Systems

picks.headline: vLLM achieves 840 tokens per second for Kimi K3 on GB300
picks.why: Demonstrates extreme single-batch decode throughput for large models using specialized CuTe DSL kernels on NVIDIA Blackwell architecture.
picks.title: Hyper Optimizing Kimi K3 in vLLM: Moving Fast and Responsibly

papers.headline: Virtual Head Attention cuts KV cache footprint beyond GQA and MLA
papers.why: Introduces linear pre/post-mixing operations to halve physical query heads and lower KV memory overhead while outperforming existing GQA and MLA architectures.
papers.title: Virtual Head Attention

papers.headline: Machine unlearning fails to prevent cross-lingual information retrieval
papers.why: Demonstrates that behavioral unlearning in one language leaves underlying knowledge accessible via semantically equivalent queries in alternative languages or scripts.
papers.title: Behavioral Forgetting Is Not Privacy in Machine Unlearning

papers.headline: RoleQ enables post-training 1.58-bit ternary LLM quantization
papers.why: Converts pre-trained LLMs to 1.59 bits per weight post-training by scaling parameters according to Transformer unit roles rather than uniform matrix layouts.
papers.title: RoleQ: Role-Aligned Scales for Converting Language Models to Ternary
